```{r}
perf <- function(X_test, y_test, beta, beta.star) {
  nzero <- which(beta != 0)
  zero  <- which(beta == 0)
  true.nzero <- which(beta.star != 0)
  true.zero  <- which(beta.star == 0)
  
  TP <- sum(nzero %in% true.nzero)
  TN <- sum(zero %in%  true.zero)
  FP <- sum(nzero %in% true.zero)
  FN <- sum(zero %in%  true.nzero)
  
  recall <- TP/(TP + FN)
  specificity <- TN/(FP + TN)
  precision <- TP/(TP + FP)
  
  recall[TP + FN == 0] <- NA
  specificity[TN + FP == 0] <- NA
  precision[TP + FP == 0] <- NA
  
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((beta - beta.star)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  rerr <- sqrt(mean((y_test - X_test %*% beta)^2))
  
  res <- round(c(precision, recall, specificity, rmse, rerr), 4)
  res[is.nan(res)] <- 0
  names(res) <- c("precision", "recall", "specificity", "rmse", "prediction")
  res
}
```

```{r}
source("methods.R")

X_train <- data1$X[data1$train, ]
y_train <- data1$y[data1$train]
X_test <- data1$X[data1$test, ]
y_test <- data1$y[data1$test]

# Méthodes
beta_ols <- getOLS(X_train, y_train)
beta_aic <- getStepwiseAIC(X_train, y_train)
beta_bic <- getStepwiseBIC(X_train, y_train)
beta_oracle <- getOracle(X_train, y_train, data1$beta)

# Évaluation
perf_ols <- perf(X_test, y_test, beta_ols, data1$beta)
perf_aic <- perf(X_test, y_test, beta_aic, data1$beta)
perf_bic <- perf(X_test, y_test, beta_bic, data1$beta)
perf_oracle <- perf(X_test, y_test, beta_oracle, data1$beta)

rbind(OLS = perf_ols,
      StepwiseAIC = perf_aic,
      StepwiseBIC = perf_bic,
      Oracle = perf_oracle)

```

```{r}
source("simulate.R")
set.seed(42)
res_indep <- map_dfr(1:10, ~ getOneSimu(.x, "indep"))
res_ar1   <- map_dfr(1:10, ~ getOneSimu(.x, "ar1", rho = 0.6))
res_block <- map_dfr(1:10, ~ getOneSimu(.x, "block", rho = 0.6))

res_all <- bind_rows(res_indep, res_ar1, res_block)
res_all
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Exemple : erreur de prédiction
ggplot(res_all, aes(x = method, y = prediction, fill = structure)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Erreur de prédiction selon la structure de corrélation",
       y = "Erreur de prédiction (test)", x = "")

# Exemple : précision du support
ggplot(res_all, aes(x = method, y = precision, fill = structure)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Précision de sélection selon la structure",
       y = "Précision", x = "")

```
